effects.description: [On Play] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 4000 base power or less.
conditions: This Character is played onto the field
You have at least 1 card in your hand
Your Leader has the {Red-Haired Pirates} type
Your opponent has at least 1 Character with base power 4000 or less
steps: If you trashed a card, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with base power 4000 or less
notes: This effect activates automatically when this Character is played
You can choose not to trash a card, in which case the K.O. effect does not happen
The K.O. target must meet the base power requirement
If your Leader has no {Red-Haired Pirates} type or the opponent has no Characters with 4000 base power or less, you can still choose to trash a card
